author: Warhammer
description:
XV26 Stealth Battlesuit teams are – by T’au military standards – strategic anomalies. Specialists in covert warfare, Stealth Battlesuit pilots are amongst the most daring and innovative warriors in the Empire. And if you’re looking to paint your very own, seek no further than this video! In this paint guide, Ollie shows you not only how to paint the awesome Vior’la scheme we’re used to, but a couple of extra ones too, including the classic T’au Sept!

Here’s a list of the paints we used in today’s video:

Base:
Dryad Bark
Mechanicus Standard Grey
Mephiston Red
The Fang

Layer:
Dawnstone
Fenrisian Grey
Gorthor Brown
Russ Grey
Wild Rider Red
White Scar

Contrast:
Black Legion

Shade:
Agrax Earthshade
Nuln Oil

Technical:
Lahmian Medium

Brushes:
S Dry
L Base
M Base
S Base
S Layer

If you enjoyed this and want to learn more, our YouTube channel has an array of beginner-friendly videos to get you started.
